recipes.recipeName: Plain Basa with Rice and Vegetables
recipes.notes: New recipe proposal, not yet test-batched. Intended batch: 12 portions; listed weights are raw/prepared ingredient amounts, not verified cooked yield. Check final yield on the first batch. No added salt does not mean sodium-free. No halal certification or clinical texture level is asserted. For a soft-meal instruction, follow the current approved preparation/texture plan; do not call a whole leg or firm vegetables suitable without that preparation. Verify procurement labels and separate preparation before allergy service. No substitutions without reassessing the complete plate. Assembly recipe for 12 intended plates. Chicken is the default non-vegetarian allergy substitute; on a fish-main service the default is basa (Jason, 2026-11-16). Any other compatible named alternative can be used. This default does not establish halal, vegan, diabetic, low-carb or clinical texture suitability.

ingredients.name: Raw plain unbreaded basa fillets, no seasoning or marinade

instructions: Check the current resident instructions and every ingredient package, including precautionary allergen statements. A plain recipe is not an allergen-free guarantee. If a product or substitution cannot be checked, stop and ask the kitchen lead; do not infer suitability from this name.

Wash hands. Physically clean, rinse and sanitise the work surface, board, probe, pan and utensils before starting. Use fresh parchment and separate clean utensils; prepare away from excluded ingredients. Keep raw meat/fish separate from produce and cooked food. No shared frying oil, stock, marinades, seasoning blends, butter or sauces.
Prepare each named component from its own recipe, in separately controlled batches. Recheck the complete plate against every current recipient restriction before assembly.

Assemble one intended protein portion, one rice side and one vegetable side per plate with separate clean utensils. Any reduced starch, extra protein, different vegetable or texture requirement comes from the resident instruction; record the actual substituted recipe, not this unchanged name.

Keep this batch covered and labelled with its dish and intended recipient/service. Use separate serving utensils. Serve hot at 60 °C (140 °F) or above; if holding or cooling is needed, use the kitchen HACCP procedure and record temperatures. Do not infer a storage life from this recipe.
